segment_paths.description: Patterns matched case-insensitively anywhere in the path (query excluded, also after one percent-decode) on a segment boundary: must start a segment and be followed by end, '/', '.', '-', '_' or '~'. Default: /.git /.svn /.hg /.env /.aws /.ssh /.DS_Store /.htpasswd /vendor/phpunit. [] = off.

query_patterns.description: Case-insensitive substrings of the query string, checked raw and after one and two percent-decodes. Default: pearcmd peclcmd allow_url_include auto_prepend_file /etc/passwd /proc/self/environ win.ini ..%2f php://filter php://input jndi:. [] = off.

exact_paths.description: Exact paths (query and trailing '/' ignored, case-insensitive). Default: /mcp /api/mcp /v1/models (MCP / LLM API reconnaissance). Override with [] on hosts that serve these endpoints.

ipv6_prefix.description: IPv6 ban prefix. 0 or 128 = per address (default); otherwise 48..128 (e.g. 64).
